introHtml: Foam pitchers and jugs are ideal for keeping beverages cold during tailgates, corporate picnics, or outdoor events. Unlike plastic or glass, foam offers superior insulation without the weight or breakage risk. Customize them with your logo using screen printing or dye sublimation for a vibrant, long-lasting finish that stands out at any gathering.
